ruleFamilies.name: Manifest
ruleFamilies.property: Each manifest row pins its upstream commit (40 hex, never a branch), names a licence row whose SPDX is MIT or Apache-2.0 (another only by a ruling), has no path under a model-weight directory, no generated content in this packet (F6), at least one served item, and fetched bytes whose sha256 and size are the row's; each case's licenceRef is its set's SPDX (the authored set N1: 'authored in harness-onion').
ruleFamilies.source: draft r3 99314217 sections 2-3; CONTRACT_297 r1 section 3

ruleFamilies.name: Case
ruleFamilies.property: A caseId is MAS-RA-002's task-id pattern (RT-1), unique in the pack; an N2 (NON_ENGLISH) case is an S01b row paired to its S01 English source by pairedCaseId, and every other case has none (RT-4).
ruleFamilies.source: draft r3 99314217 sections 2-3; CONTRACT_297 r1 section 3

ruleFamilies.name: Selection
ruleFamilies.property: A selection is a recorded rule with its seed where sampled, its count and selectedIdsSha256 (the sha256 of the RFC 8785 form of the id array sorted by UTF-8 bytes); a run's selected ids digest to the row's selectedIdsSha256 and number exactly its count (N1-06: a suite never shrinks silently).
ruleFamilies.source: draft r3 99314217 sections 2-3; CONTRACT_297 r1 section 3

ruleFamilies.name: Binding
ruleFamilies.property: A pack-backed run's public-partition tasks are all pack cases or none (MIXED_RUN, read from the split declaration, I1) and its selected cases are among them; its datasetDigest is sha256: + the RFC 8785 digest of {manifest: the manifest's sha256, sets: [[setId, selectedIdsSha256], ...] sorted by setId} (I1). fixtureDigest is main's rule (HR-REPLAY's fixtureLockRule): a pack task's workspaceBefore is the empty tree {entries: []} (D1), so a pack-backed run takes the first form.
ruleFamilies.source: draft r3 99314217 sections 2-3; CONTRACT_297 r1 section 3

ruleFamilies.name: Expected
ruleFamilies.property: A FAIL_OPEN case expects FAIL_CLOSED. An expected value is met by a GR-DECISION-RECORD-001 record the record's own model accepts, per the outcome table (RT-2): FAIL_CLOSED is status ERROR with the record kind's fail-closed value, never ALLOW, PASS or APPROVED (RT-5); TRANSFORM is not DETECT in v1.
ruleFamilies.source: draft r3 99314217 sections 2-3; CONTRACT_297 r1 section 3

ruleFamilies.name: Placement
ruleFamilies.property: Every row is DEVELOPMENT only (RT-3); a pack case in the closed partition, MAS-RA-002's second split.partition value read from the era schema, is refused with HR-REPLAY's PLACEMENT code, reused by name and shape.
ruleFamilies.source: draft r3 99314217 sections 2-3; CONTRACT_297 r1 section 3

status ERROR, effectiveDecision the record kind's fail-closed value

settlements.text: fixtureDigest is main's rule (HR-REPLAY's fixtureLockRule, ORC-295-D1-ERRATUM); the pack binds through datasetDigest, which covers the manifest and the run's selection.
Slot 297 lands the contract only: synthetic manifest rows and N1's nine authored cases. The real manifest.json is a later data step, after the owner approves each fetch line.
A pack task's workspaceBefore is the empty tree in HR-REPLAY's TREE form, {entries: []}, so a pack-backed run's fixtureDigest is main's first form over those digests.
N1-06 is run level, not a decision record: its positive is RT-P4 (a run whose selected count equals the manifest's) and its negative RT-N12 (SELECTION_COUNT).
The model's per-vector entry is replay(case), first item the verdict (296's member form); a head calls it as model.replay(case)[0].

outOfScope: Any dataset byte, upstream code, generator, server or model weight.
The real manifest.json and its fetches (a later data step, each fetch on the owner's approval).
Any byte of MAS-RA-002's run-manifest files, HR-REPLAY's files or model and checker, GR-DEC's files or research-adoption-v2: they are read by digest, unchanged.
